_comment: EMPTY UNTIL A HUMAN LABELS. Same posture as review-eval/naver/v1/labels.json: an empty
seed is the honest state, not a placeholder to be filled with plausible-looking rows.
Each entry carries ONLY the review-id fingerprint and the operator's judgment — tier,
reasonCode, tags — all from the closed vocabularies in RUBRIC.md sections 2 and 3. Never
the body, the raw 리뷰글번호, the rating, the date, the body length, the stratum, the
product, or any seller identity. The harness re-derives rating, length and stratum from
the local database at evaluation time. See RUBRIC.md section 5, and section 3.3 for why
there is no free-text rationale field.
Produced by tools/review-triage-calibration/derive-labels.mjs from a local worksheet that
is never committed. Written by hand only to fix a schema error, never to add a label.
